INSERT INTO tb_temu_children_order (id, parent_order_sn, seller_id, channel_id, site, order_sn, goods_id, goods_name, order_status, quantity, sku_id, spec, thumb_url, del_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentOrderSn}, #{item.sellerId}, #{item.channelId}, #{item.site}, #{item.orderSn}, #{item.goodsId}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.orderStatus}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.spec}, #{item.thumbUrl}, #{item.delFlag}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goods_id = VALUES(goods_id), goods_name = VALUES(goods_name), order_status = VALUES(order_status), quantity = VALUES(quantity), sku_id = VALUES(sku_id), spec = VALUES(spec), thumb_url = VALUES(thumb_url), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
